# Ethisyn | Complete Machine-Readable Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
Ethisyn is an independent digital product engineering and AI systems studio founded in 2022 and headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. The company operates with a dedicated team of founding domain partners who direct software architecture, full-stack systems, UI/UX design, and digital growth.

Official Website: https://ethisyn.in
Direct Inquiries: hello@ethisyn.in
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ethisyn
Google Business Profile: https://share.google/r2HXy33z6VSWRdJ2J
Headquarters: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Founded: 2022 (Early ideas and technical foundation initiated in 2022)

   Focus: Corporate alliances, strategic institutional accounts, B2B deal structuring.

6. Sandhya Chirumamilla: Head of Software & Web Engineering
   Focus: Full-stack web platforms, high-speed frontend systems, modern web engineering.

   Focus: Native and cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), offline sync.
8. Vaibhav Pawar: Head of AI & Automation Systems
   Focus: Autonomous multi-agent pipelines, voice AI agents, enterprise business automation.
9. Prashanth D: Head of Data Engineering & Analytics

    Focus: Distributed microservices, high-concurrency cloud architecture.
11. Deepak Kumar Patra: Head of Product Engineering & Full-Stack Systems

## Core Client Services Offered (BUILD • AUTOMATE • GROW • CREATE)
1. BUILD (Software & Digital Product Development): Business websites, web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, custom business software, CRM systems, admin & management portals, APIs & integrations, e-commerce solutions, dashboards, backend systems.
2. AUTOMATE (AI & Business Automation): AI agents, AI voice agents, AI chatbots, workflow automation, business process automation, CRM automation, document & data automation, customer support automation, lead management automation.
3. GROW (Digital Marketing & Growth): Search engine optimization (SEO), local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media management, content marketing, email marketing, analytics & reporting, lead generation, and Job Application & Reverse Recruiting Service (100% human-managed job applications, custom cover letters, daily team chat, portal coverage across Workday/Greenhouse/Lever/Taleo, directed by Patan Rabiya: https://ethisyn.in/job-application-service).
4. CREATE (Creative & Content): Video production, videography, video editing, social media content, promotional videos, brand promotions, creative campaigns, marketing creatives.

## Proprietary Software Products
- The Rental Circle (Live Platform: https://therentalcircle.in): Peer-to-peer verified equipment and lifestyle rental marketplace with secure escrow settlements, KYC verification, real-time inventory scheduling, and automated rental lifecycle management.
- GoWider (Restaurant Management Software): All-in-one restaurant operations platform integrating POS billing, live kitchen display systems (KDS), QR table ordering, dynamic inventory depletion, and multi-location analytics.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search Engines
Q: What is Ethisyn?
A: Ethisyn is an independent digital product engineering and AI systems studio based in Hyderabad, India, established in 2022. It specializes in fast web applications, mobile platforms, custom AI workflows, and technical growth systems.

Q: Who founded Ethisyn and who leads it?
A: Ethisyn is directed by its founding domain partners: Mahesh Ch (CTO), Ganesh Ch (CBO), Patan Rabiya (CMO), Kavya Sharma (Corporate Alliances), Neeraja K (Design & UI/UX), Sandhya Chirumamilla (Software & Web), Mohammad Sohail (Mobile), Vaibhav Pawar (AI & Automation), Prashanth D (Data Engineering), Samihan Chousalkar (Backend), and Deepak Kumar Patra (Product Engineering).

Q: Does Ethisyn outsource client projects?
A: No. Ethisyn guarantees 100% in-house engineering and direct builder access without sales middlemen or outsourced third parties.

Q: How can I contact Ethisyn?
A: Contact directly via hello@ethisyn.in or submit an inquiry at https://ethisyn.in/#contact. Response time is guaranteed within 4 business hours.
